full_benchmark.essential_denominator: All positive judgments labeled essential for the question.
full_benchmark.acceptable_denominator: All recommendation_allowed positive judgments for the question.

present_source.essential_denominator: Essential requirements frozen as present_search_eligible in the cohort manifest.
present_source.acceptable_denominator: Recommendation-allowed requirements frozen as present_search_eligible in the cohort manifest.

essential_recall.question_formula: unique essential canonical sources retrieved in ranks 1..k / essential canonical sources in cohort
essential_recall.macro_formula: unweighted mean of eligible question recall; null-gold questions excluded
essential_recall.micro_formula: summed unique essential hits / summed essential requirements
essential_recall.null_gold_policy: Exclude from recall, count as null_gold, and retain in scoped-zero reporting.

legacy_acceptable_source_coverage.formula: unique acceptable canonical sources retrieved in ranks 1..k / acceptable canonical sources for the question
legacy_acceptable_source_coverage.purpose: Historical bridge only; never label this precision.

strict_exact_gold_precision.formula: first occurrences of exact or adjudicated-equivalent gold sources in ranks 1..k / k

graded_acceptable_precision.formula: sum of the highest normalized gold gain earned by each unique canonical source in ranks 1..k / k
graded_acceptable_precision.short_list_policy: Missing slots and non-gold results have zero gain.

duplicate_policy.canonicalization: Use only reviewed asset bindings in the frozen cohort manifest.
duplicate_policy.credit: The first ranked asset resolving to a canonical benchmark source may earn recall/precision/role credit; later equivalents earn zero.
duplicate_policy.rank_slots: Every returned asset consumes its physical rank slot even when it is a duplicate.

role_coverage.formula: required analytical roles with at least one eligible canonical source retrieved in ranks 1..k / required analytical roles in cohort

join_policy.overstatement: A proposed join_proven route is unsupported unless the frozen gold assessment for the same canonical source set is join_proven.
